text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy. The premier educational 
institution leading into the Twinkle 
Series. 
Every year, thousands of applicants 
attempt its entrance exam.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The passing standards are extraordinarily 
high, so most horsegirls join development 
clubs 
from early childhood to hone their skills 
before applying. For example—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"Hillesta Academy"—Japan's largest 
horsegirl development club. 
A racing school equipped with top-tier 
coaches, the finest facilities, and every 
advantage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a powerhouse club that produces 
countless racers for the Twinkle Series— 
and it's girls with that kind of solid 
backing who usually take the exam.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. 
Thank you so much for taking the time 
today!
choice_data_list: Morning! I'm looking forward to it, too.
Morning! I'm looking forward to it, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To watch Daring Tact run today, I changed 
my original travel plans 
and arranged to meet her near a ranch 
nestled at the foot of the Erimo 
mountains.
choice_data_list:
So, we're not heading up the mountain 
today?

So, we're not heading up the mountain 
today?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If you're going to get an accurate 
look at how I currently run, 
I figured a proper course would be best.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Hello there, I'm one of Daring 
Tact's neighbors. 
I'll drive you over to the course, so hop 
on in~.
choice_data_list: Oh... thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After getting a ride from the local 
resident and stepping out of the truck... 
I find an expansive turf course laid out 
in a clearing carved into the mountain.
choice_data_list: It's so spacious and well laid out.
It's so spacious and well laid out!

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
You really think so? Oh, that makes me so 
happy to hear. 
All of us around here cleared the land and 
built this course together, you see.
choice_data_list:
Wait... you made this entire place by 
hand!?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Sure enough, looking closer, the furlong 
poles in the distance are just painted 
lumber, 
and the inner rails look repurposed from 
farm fencing.

text_block_list.name: Local Residents
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, you made it!" "Nice to meetcha, 
Trainer~" 
"Be right there! Brought some fresh milk 
from this morning's milking!"
choice_data_list: Um, are they... neighbors too?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Everyone has watched over me ever 
since I was a little girl... 
They let me borrow their mountain land and 
help me out in so many ways.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She calls it "help," but clearing this 
land from scratch, planting turf, 
and keeping it carefully maintained 
despite its rustic feel... is no small 
feat.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm going to go warm up! 
Please take good care of the trainer, 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The locals support her while continuing 
their own daily chores. 
It feels like an extraordinary level of 
devotion for just a neighborhood kid...
choice_data_list: Why do you all do so much for her...?

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
Because Daring Tact... 
is the dream of every single one of us 
around here.
choice_data_list: Your dream...?

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
Her mother's health wasn't good, you 
see... So when Daring Tact 
was still real small, they moved out here 
for her recovery.

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
And since her mother couldn't move around 
much, we looked after the little one. 
Took her up into our mountains, let her 
play out by the cape...

text_block_list.name: Earnest-Looking Man
text_block_list.text:
And then she fell head over heels in love 
with nature! Before we knew it, 
she was rolling around outside all day 
long... grew up bursting with energy.

text_block_list.name: Kind Woman
text_block_list.text:
The way she ran looked just like the 
horsegirls we saw on TV... 
So everyone gave her a gentle nudge, 
telling her she ought to give racing a 
shot.

text_block_list.name: Cheerful Woman
text_block_list.text:
Having a girl like that come out of Hidaka 
makes our chests swell with pride! 
Daring Tact is truly something incredible! 
She'll pass for sure!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, please take a good, hard look at 
her running. 
—I'm sure it'll make you lean right in!
choice_data_list: Lean in...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Sorry to keep you waiting! 
I'm going to run 800 meters at full 
sprint!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Even though I'm not involved in the 
entrance exams, I know the reality. 
Every applicant gathered there has 
sparkling talent... but only a handful 
will pass.
choice_data_list:
(...I'm getting a little nervous to 
watch.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that I've felt the townspeople's 
heartfelt hopes firsthand, I want her to 
succeed, too. 
However, depending on where her abilities 
stand right now...—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAH...!!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I unconsciously lean forward. Daring Tact 
storms across the rough turf 
without the slightest wobble in her 
core... What phenomenal physical ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And above all, the sheer determination in 
her eyes as she pushes onward— 
there is something truly extraordinary 
dwelling within that fierce intensity.
choice_data_list:
(Unpolished... yet overwhelmingly 
brilliant!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
*Haah*... *haah*... 
...Trainer—
choice_data_list: You have an unbelievable stride...!
You have an unbelievable stride...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list:
How did you build such an incredible 
core!?

How did you build such an incredible 
core!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
From the mountain, of course! Most of my 
training consists of custom regimens 
I developed up there... Um, let me 
demonstrate! Come with me!

text_block_list.name: Gentle Man
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, you leaned right in, just like I 
said. 
Whenever anyone watches Daring Tact 
run—they can't help but lean forward.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—For example... here on this cape. Strong 
winds constantly batter it... 
It's not uncommon for gusts to reach 
thirty meters per second.
choice_data_list: I-I can barely even stand...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Even so... I run... straight into this 
wind! 
HAAAAAAAH...!!
choice_data_list:
Incredible... So this is the secret behind 
her core...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
choice_data_list: ...Um, what's this for?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This is training to become one with 
nature. By keeping my breathing to a 
minimum 
and sensing the presence of living 
creatures... Out in the open like this, 
it's far more difficult.
choice_data_list:
Training to sharpen your five senses, 
then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. A mountain is a place where life is 
exposed raw... By exposing myself to 
nature 
and stepping outside the boundary of 
safety—my senses grow razor-sharp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her various training exercises 
makes everything clear. That fierce 
intensity 
she displayed... stems from an acute sense 
of survival nurtured by the mountains.
choice_data_list: (She's incredible. ...And yet—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to ask you plainly. 
—Do I have what it takes to pass the exam 
for Tracen Academy?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She possesses astounding physical 
capabilities, and her talent is 
unmistakable. 
Even so... when considering the caliber of 
the other applicants—
choice_data_list:
...As you are right now, it might be 
tough.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! ...I see, so I'm lacking the ability 
after all. 
Because I never attended a development 
club—
choice_data_list:
No, the strength you built in the 
mountains is phenomenal!

No, the strength you built in the 
mountains is phenomenal!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...—! Thank you so much. 
Then... what is it that I'm lacking?
choice_data_list: Your racing "form."
Your racing "form."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Renowned development clubs have 
established methodologies. Using objective 
metrics, 
they mold each runner into the exact form 
that maximizes their potential.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Raw physical ability alone isn't enough to 
win races. If you don't shape that raw 
power 
into a form optimized for racing—you won't 
survive the exam.
choice_data_list:
Could you give me a little time? I want to 
find the right form for you.

Could you give me a little time? I want to 
find the right form for you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
What? You would do that for me, Trainer? 
...I would be incredibly grateful, but... 
aren't you on vacation?
choice_data_list: (...Oh, right, I totally forgot!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Forget the vacation. With talent like this 
right in front of me, 
sightseeing is the last thing on my 
mind—after all, I'm a trainer.
choice_data_list: I want to bring out your full potential!
I want to bring out your full potential!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you from the bottom of my heart. 
In that case... I will gladly accept your 
kind offer.

title: Running the Mountains, Over and Over, and Then
